The '''{{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}}''' is used to grow many of the crops in the game. How quickly things grow, the yield, and their quality is highly dependent on the [[fertilizer]]s you use, any active [[sermon]]s, and your chosen [[perks]]. For more information see the page on [[farming]].
